summary: Avalanche Treasury Corporation filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff letter dated October 7, 2026, stating the company regained compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The closing bid price of Class A common stock (AVAT) had been at or above $1.00 for 13 consecutive business days from September 18 through October 6, 2026, resolving the August 6, 2026 deficiency notice. The matter is closed; no deal terms, advisors or board recommendations were disclosed. What to watch: any renewed sub-$1 trading that would restart the compliance clock.
